usedFor: Copper tracks leads, opportunities and people, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Opportunity” in Copper, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: The action triggers a command on your computers, so a new opportunity can start local work.

watchOut: “Updated Opportunity” and other update triggers fire on every change, so one record can run “Trigger Command” twice.
